an8.74:1.1: 81 ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nādike viharati giñjakāvasathe.
an8.74:1.3: maraṇassati bhikkhave bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānā
an8.74:2.1: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca bhikkhave maraṇassati kathaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānā
an8.74:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu divase nikkhante rattiyā paṭihitāya iti paṭisañcikkhati
an8.74:2.4: ahi vā maṃ ḍaṃseyya vicchikā vā maṃ ḍaṃseyya satapadī vā maṃ ḍaṃseyya
an8.74:2.5: tena me assa kālakiriyā so mamassantarāyo
an8.74:2.6: upakkhalitvā vā papateyyaṃ bhattaṃ vā me bhuttaṃ byāpajjeyya pittaṃ vā me kuppeyya semhaṃ vā me kuppeyya satthakā vā me vātā kuppeyyuṃ manussā vā maṃ upakkameyyuṃ amanussā vā maṃ upakkameyyuṃ
an8.74:2.7: tena me assa kālakiriyā so mamassantarāyoti
an8.74:2.9: atthi nu kho me pāpakā akusalā dhammā appahīnā ye me assu rattiṃ kālaṃ karontassa antarāyāyāti
an8.74:3.1: sace bhikkhave bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti
an8.74:3.2: atthi me pāpakā akusalā dhammā appahīnā ye me assu rattiṃ kālaṃ karontassa antarāyāyāti tena bhikkhave bhikkhunā tesaññeva pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya adhimatto chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appaṭivānī ca sati ca sampajaññañca karaṇīyaṃ
an8.74:4.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave ādittacelo vā ādittasīso vā tasseva celassa vā sīsassa vā nibbāpanāya adhimattaṃ chandañca vāyāmañca ussāhañca ussoḷhiñca appaṭivāniñca satiñca sampajaññañca kareyya
an8.74:4.2: evameva kho bhikkhave tena bhikkhunā tesaññeva pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya adhimatto chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appaṭivānī ca sati ca sampajaññañca karaṇīyaṃ
an8.74:5.1: sace pana bhikkhave bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti
an8.74:5.2: natthi me pāpakā akusalā dhammā appahīnā ye me assu rattiṃ kālaṃ karontassa antarāyāyāti tena bhikkhave bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
